Fishing Manual:
The type of Bait and Fishing Rod you use affects duration and success rate for fishing.


Bait: fishing time and waiting time

Fishing Time depends on the Bait type. Bait from the shop Fishing: 105 sec., Waiting: 15 sec. It takes 120 seconds for one fishing attempt.
Fishing Rod reduces fishing time

Fishing Rod reduces fishing time. Normal Fishing Rod and Sturdy Fishing Rod does not affect fishing time, but using the Angler's Fishing Rod - Stage 1 reduces fishing time.
Fishing Shot increases the success rate for fishing

Fishing Shot affects the success rate for fishing.
